scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run sdk:build && npm run extensions:build && npm run frontend:bundle
scripts.architecture: node scripts/checkBuildLayout.mjs && node scripts/check-extension-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-scrollbar-contract.mjs && node --test scripts/fileAssociations.test.mjs
scripts.sdk:build: npm run build --workspace @sideral/extension-sdk && npm run build --workspace @sideral/extension-testkit
scripts.extension:markdown:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.markdown-preview && npm run test --workspace sideral.markdown-preview && npm run build --workspace sideral.markdown-preview && npm run extension:tool -- check build/extensions/markdown-preview
scripts.extension:amxx:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run test --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run build --workspace sideral.amxx-pawn && npm run extension:tool -- check build/extensions/amxx-pawn
scripts.extension:discord:check: npm run typecheck --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run test --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run build --workspace sideral.discord-presence && npm run extension:tool -- check build/extensions/discord-presence
scripts.extensions:build: npm run extension:markdown:build && npm run extension:amxx:build && npm run extension:discord:build
scripts.extensions:check: npm run extension:markdown:check && npm run extension:amxx:check && npm run extension:discord:check
scripts.security: npm run security:npm && npm run security:rust
scripts.release:local: npm run tauri build && npm run extensions:package:dev
scripts.check: npm run architecture && npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run sdk:build && npm run extensions:check && npm run test && npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test && npm run frontend:bundle && npm run security
